goal: Prevent node crashes or shutdown hangs caused by background chainstate compaction exhausting disk space
Defer compaction with an explanatory warning when free disk space is less than the chainstate size
Skip automatic compaction for in-memory databases and make compaction start and finish logs visible
agreement: Contested objection: do not warn on skipped compaction as low disk space should be supported (andrewtoth)
Verified low disk space warning triggers as expected using fallocate (danielabrozzoni)
Support with review of compaction behavior and wording (stickies-v, optout21)
Concept approval with open questions on warning visibility and in-memory rationale (stringintech, sedited)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes node crashes and shutdown hangs caused by disk exhaustion during compaction
Protects node operators running with tight storage margins from unexpected out-of-disk failures
